# Design point P014

## Description

Repositories are replicated across distinct racks so a rack-level failure does not remove the repository copies. Clients access this replicated repository while traversing commits, trees, and parents through sequentially dependent Git object lookups; the placement improves durability, but does not itself remove the traversal’s dependency-related latency or metadata work.
